feat: Add suggestions for no-prototype-builtins (#17677)

* feat: Add suggestion for no-prototype-builtins

allowed-mutation: Modify only these supplied source paths: lib/rules/no-prototype-builtins.js. Do not add, delete, rename, or change modes of other paths.
